name: Operation and performance of the ICARUS T600 cryogenic plant at Gran Sasso underground Laboratory

summary.plain: A technical report on how ICARUS's liquid-argon cooling plant worked underground at Gran Sasso, Italy, from 2010 to 2013.
summary.technical: arXiv:1504.01556: operation and performance of the ICARUS T600 cryogenic and purification plant during three years of run in Hall B of LNGS (May 2010 - June 2013) on the CNGS beam.
